name: Mortus' wife
desc:
[Mortus](entity:mortus)' late wife was known to fish alongside her husband. One day, the pair attempted to fish up an "octopus", likely a Nautilodaunt, by luring it to land. Unfortunately for her, the creature proved more dangerous than expected and killed her. Mortus swore off attempting to catch more of these creatures.

Mortus later recounted this tale to the Pathfinder.
